create_rmsprop_optimizer: create an RMSProp optimizer instance with custom learning rate, momentum, and weight decay parameters
build_rmsprop_from_config: build an RMSProp optimizer from a configuration dictionary with validated hyperparameters and defaults
prepare_rmsprop_with_param_groups: prepare the RMSProp optimizer by wrapping torch.optim.RMSprop with the given parameter groups
register_rmsprop_optimizer: register the RMSProp optimizer class under the name rmsprop in the ClassyOptimizer registry
validate_rmsprop_config: validate RMSProp config parameters ensuring momentum and alpha are in [0,1) and eps is positive
